title: Requests on the West Coast and the Young Tuxedo Brass Band
summary: West Coast audiences request spirituals; Robinson played with the Young Tuxedo band but couldn't do the walking.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene

blocks.x: You know, let me tell you one thing, you know, see on the west coast, they're where we go play, and people, they want you to play special things. Like in Sweet Byron By, the close to walk with you, over the glory line, people, they actually play these things, you know?
